t: A sturdy classroom robot that grows from block coding to Python.
steps: Buy the mBot2 from the Makeblock store or a shop such as RobotShop or Stemfinity.
Build the robot with the guide in the box. It takes about thirty minutes.
Charge the battery with a USB-C cable.
Install the free mBlock app on a computer or tablet, or open the web version.
Connect the robot with the USB-C cable and pick CyberPi as the device.
Drag blocks to show a message on the screen and play a sound.
Try a block program that drives forward and turns.
Switch to Python mode later to see your blocks as code.
meta: Open Board. From $54.99. A few stores.
